title.narrative: Tana & Beles Integrated Water Resources Development

description.narrative: Develop enabling institutions and investments for integrated planning, management and development in the Tana and Beles Sub-basins for integrated water resources development.

The objective of the Tana & Beles Integrated Water Resources Development Project is to develop enabling institutions and investments for integrated planning, management, and development in the Tana and Beles Sub-basins to accelerate sustainable growth. There are four components to the project. The first component of the project is sub-basin resources planning and management. This component aims to develop the enabling institutional infrastructure and capacity necessary for stimulating and managing sustainable investments in the Tana and Beles sub-basins. The two sub-components will be supported: (i) water resource information system development; and (ii) resource planning and management capacity-building. The second component of the project is natural resource management investments. This component aims to undertake critical investments to improve the natural resources management in the Tana sub-basin. Given the urgency of such investments in the Tana sub-basin and the early nature of engagement in the Beles sub-basin, this component is confined to investments solely in the Tana Sub-basin. The two sub-components will be supported by: (i) watershed development; and (ii) flood management. The third component of the project is growth-oriented investment facilitation, this component aims to support the institutional capacity and investment facilitation required for sustainable development of the Tana and Beles sub-basins to realize the growth vision for the region. The two sub-components will be supported: (i) development agency support by; (ii) growth-oriented investment preparation. The fourth and the final component of the project is project management. This component aims to support overall project planning, coordination, management, quality oversight, technical supervision, effective procurement and financial management, as well as consolidated monitoring and reporting of project activities.

baseline.value: No Sub-basin organizations at the beginning of the project

target.value: Interactive knowledge base products launched; knowledge base and analytical tools support sub-basin plan development for Tana andBeles subbasins.

actual.value:
Sub-basin organizations established, staffed and physical infrastructure completed for BeSBO and TaSBO. Server is installed forboth sub basins. Different trainings by BRL and SIAP-MICROS conducted for the two sub basins to operationalize HIS-BISequipment.
Interactive knowledge base products completed and launched; knowledge base and analytical tools were used to supportsub-basin plan development for Tana and Beles subbasins.

title.narrative: Flood Management Information System developed and used routinely

baseline.value: No existing effective system for flood forecasting and communication at regional-level

target.value: Flood forecasting and early warning system in place and used for the flood-prone areas around Lake Tana.

actual.value:
First Radar in the Country delivered and installed. (RADAR delivered and civil/Infrastructures work and foundation for radarinstallation completed. RADAR tower and equipment installation completed.) Training completed for ABA and NMA staffs.
TaSBO builton flood forecasting and early warning systems developed by ENTRO for use in flood prone areas of Lake Tana.

title.narrative: Soil Erosion Monitoring and Evaluation system developed and monitoring network in place

baseline.value: No soil and water monitoring system is in place in the project area of Amhara region

target.value: M&E system and network for soil erosion monitoring and evaluation operational by Bureaus of Water Resource, Amhara region (formicro-watersheds) and TaSBO (for sub-watersheds)

actual.value:
NRM baseline survey completed. M&E system and network for soil erosion monitoring and evaluation established and isoperational.
Hydrological gauging stations at sub watershed level established and Hydrological data has been regularly collectedand analyzed.

title.narrative: Initial integrated basin management plans for Tana and Beles sub-basins developed and discussed by key stakeholders (regional bureau s and authorities, Basin Organizations, civil society organizations

baseline.value: No water resource plans for Tana and Beles sub-basins exist.

target.value: Sub-basin plans for Tana and Beles developed and discussed with key stakeholders.

actual.value: Final Draft water resources management plans for each sub-basin were prepared in consultation with senior officials and keystakeholders. Final plans have been widely consulted on and reviewed at both regional and national levels. Final plans will bepresented to the Abbay Basin Authority Higher Council at its next meeting.

title.narrative: Water resources monitoring network operational and information collected and used routinely

target.value: Enhanced HIS/BIS water resources monitoring network (including radar, gauging, and earth observation products) for Tana and Belessub-basins operational; Comprehensive Basin knowledge base and supporting analytical/ modeling tools used to support planning andoperational decisions.

actual.value:
43 Hydrological monitoring stations established and are operational (Civil Works and installation completed, 100% achieved); 33Meteorological monitoring stations established and are operational (civil works and installation completed, 100%achieved).
Enhanced HIS/BIS water resources monitoring network (including radar, gauging, and earth observation products) for Tanaand Beles sub-basins operational; Comprehensive Basin knowledge base and supporting analytical/ modeling tools used to supportplanning and operational decisions.

title.narrative: Sub-basin organizations operational (With permanent heads appointed and core staff and approved basin plans in place)

target.value: office buildings with adequate knowledge base, analytical tools, and capacity for sub-basin planning and management

actual.value: Sub-basin organizations established, staffed and capacity strengthened. Physical infrastructure completed for BeSBO and TaSBO.Server is installed for both sub basins. Different trainings by BRL and SIAP-MICROS were completed for the two sub basins tooperationalize HIS-BIS equipment.
